messages.subject: Shiny Server Package Location
parts:
I have a package that I need to update on my Shiny Server from Github. 

I have been unable to update it so I uninstalled it for each .libPath choice from sudo in command line. Even after uninstalling from every place, when I run the app, the functions unique to that package still work. Is there another location where the package may be installed to? 

Thanks.

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server Package Location
parts:
It's possible you installed the package another user and shiny has access to that user's library perhaps?

If Shiny is able to use a package and you have no idea where that package is, what you can do is make shiny tell you where the package is. Just make a textOutput(), and in the renderText() function make it output `system.file(package = packagename)` and then in your app it'll show you the path

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server Package Location
parts: Yeah, keep in mind that (by default) Shiny Server runs as the "shiny" user. So if you're doing library stuff on your normal user account, that will likely not affect what Shiny Server apps see. From an ssh prompt, you can use "sudo su - shiny" to change to the "shiny" user, then run R from that prompt, then call .libPaths() or system.file or remove.packages or whatever.
